name: commvault-mcp
description: Unofficial wrapper: query and manage your Commvault environment (jobs, SLA, storage, users, plans) in natural language.
long_description: Not an official Commvault release -- a personally-built, source-available wrapper around Commvault's official open-source MCP server (github.com/Commvault/commvault-mcp-server), packaged as a one-click Claude Desktop Extension. The vendored server code is unmodified and Apache-2.0 licensed from Commvault; this bundle adds only a small bootstrap script (see repository) to bridge Claude Desktop's install-time config into that server's credential/config format. Each install authenticates with an access token you generate yourself in Command Center under your own Commvault login -- the extension never uses a shared credential. No Python, uv, or terminal setup required; Claude Desktop handles the runtime via the bundled uv package manager. Review the source before installing.

is_metallic.title: SaaS / Metallic tenant
is_metallic.description: Set this first -- it changes what the Server URL field below means. Enable if this is a Commvault Cloud (Metallic) SaaS tenant; leave off for an on-premises CommCell.

cc_server_url.title: Commvault Server URL (on-premises only)
cc_server_url.description: Ignored if 'SaaS / Metallic tenant' above is enabled -- the extension always uses https://api.metallic.io regardless of what's typed here, never your tenant's pod hostname (e.g. m119.metallic.io) from the browser address bar. On-premises only: enter your CommCell's WebConsole/API base URL, e.g. https://yourcompany.example.com.

access_token.title: Access Token
access_token.description: Generate this yourself in Command Center: Security > Users and User Groups > your account > Create Access Token. Tied to your own login — never shared. Recommended: choose Custom scope with read-only/view access rather than All, unless you specifically need this extension to suspend/resume/kill jobs or manage users.

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Issued alongside the access token in the same Command Center step.
